author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a double open-end wrench from top left to bottom right crossed with a screwdriver (outlined handle at the bottom left, shaft to the top right); reads as crossed tools like the reference. The rejected drawing was an abstract arrow-like shape.
omissions: The wrench shaft and screwdriver shaft are single strokes (the reference outlines them); the screwdriver's flat blade tip is a plain round end.
drawing_plan: SQUARE: wrench on x=y with U jaws about (12,12)/(36,36), prongs to the edges, shaft (16,16)-(32,32); screwdriver handle corners (6,36),(12,42),(20,34),(14,28), shaft from (17,31) to (37,11); shafts cross at (24,24).
